crossRefs.note: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the…
If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

translations.web: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
translations.bsb: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.
translations.kjv: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
translations.asv: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.
